description: California Water Rights Irrigation Use Annual Reports is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California State Water Resources Control Board. This list includes detail information for IRRIGATION WATER USE as reported annually under each water right as stored in the State Water Resources Control Board's "Electronic Water Rights Information Management System" (EWRIMS) database. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California State Water Resources Control Board. Its tags are Annual Report, Crop types, Division of water Rights, Irrigation, Regulatory. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, DOC, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-08-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
